description: Render an HTML string to a PDF with a headless browser, so layout, CSS (flexbox, grid, print styles), images and web fonts come out as in a browser print. It takes HTML text only: there is no URL input, and JavaScript is switched off, so scripts do not run and pages that build themselves with JavaScript render empty. External resources (images, stylesheets, fonts) load only over https from public hosts; anything else (http, file, private or internal addresses, redirects to them) is blocked and skipped, and the PDF is still made. Data URIs work and are the safest way to include images. Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, margin in points (default 36), backgrounds printed by default, optional scale. html is capped at 1 MB, the document at 50 pages and 16 MB, external resources at 50 requests and 40 MB, and rendering at 15 seconds. A render that reaches the renderer counts as 5 requests against the monthly quota, not 1, whether it succeeds or fails; the html argument lists the cases that count for less. Resource, image and font details are in the html argument. pdf_text_to_pdf handles Markdown, text or CSV with no HTML, and pdf_invoice builds an invoice from data. Returns the result written to output_path, or inline as an application/pdf resource when output_path is omitted (results over 7 MB are never returned inline and need output_path); an existing file at output_path is overwritten. The source is never modified.

html.description: The document as HTML text, up to 1 MB of UTF-8. A full document or a fragment. Frames, iframes, objects, embeds, audio and video are not rendered, and an inline or fetched image is decoded and checked first. Common fonts (Helvetica, Arial, Times, Courier and generic families) render as Liberation faces, metric-compatible with the originals. Images: 16 megapixels at most each (96 in total); PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG (simplified: scripts, style sheets, filters, masks, embedded images and links are removed; inline style colours are kept); AVIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, animated PNG and colour-bitmap fonts are not supported, and an image in an unsupported format or over a limit fails the request (a missing image, such as a 404 or a tracking pixel, is skipped). Quota: once the renderer is reached every outcome counts as 5 requests, failures included; a refusal before a browser starts (for example an inline image refused with image_too_large or unsupported_image, with the image named in the message) counts as 1; only input validation errors and a busy or unreachable renderer count nothing.

margin.description: Margin on every side in points, 0-144. Default 36.

output_path.description: Path of a .pdf file to write the result to, inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory); an existing file there is overwritten. Without it (as when running remotely) the PDF is returned inline as an application/pdf resource for the client to save.

print_background.description: Print background colors and images. Default true.

name: pdf_html_to_pdf

blocked_requests.description: External requests the page made that were blocked by the network policy

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

output_path.description: Absolute path written, when output_path was supplied

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource, when output_path was omitted

title: Create a PDF from HTML
